summary: Sketches gain a point-on-curve relation that keeps a point on the full circle of an arc or circle, beyond an arc's ends, while the curve moves or changes size. Coincident now accepts a point and an arc or circle, both after choosing the tool and from the Constrain menu for a selection; no separate constraint tool is added, and the relation list and constraint feedback name it Point on curve. With Create relations on, which is the default, a drawn point snapped along an arc or circle, or where a guide crosses one, keeps that relation. Trim keeps a new cut inside a cutting arc or circle on it, as it already did for cutting lines, and keeps an existing point-on-curve on the arc that retains the trimmed arc's identity or on the arc left by a trimmed circle. The relation compiles to the existing native equal-length and distance-to-parameter equations and removes exactly one freedom. Trim previews now name each cut's possible relation in attachment or attachments instead of attachLineId or attachLineIds. Trimming an edge to an existing point that a point-on-line or point-on-curve relation holds on that same edge now removes that relation with the piece, where it previously failed with an invalid sketch.
warning: Potentially breaking for CAD files: a document whose sketch contains a point-on-curve relation cannot be opened by release 0.0.773 or earlier, because their strict relation schema rejects the new kind. Existing documents are not migrated or rewritten; only sketches where a person or agent adds the relation carry it. New curved trim cuts and arc or circle snaps add it by default: the Trim command keeps every new cut inside a cutting arc or circle on that curve, and drawing adds it while Create relations is on. Potentially breaking for agents using trim-sketch-entity: the trimPreview fields attachLineId and attachLineIds are replaced by attachment and attachments, which name {kind: point-on-line, lineId} or {kind: point-on-curve, curveId}, or null at an existing endpoint. The attachRelationId and attachRelationIds request fields keep their shape; a relation ID for a cut inside an arc or circle, which used to reject with invalid-sketch-trim-attachment, now adds Point on curve. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output.

checklist.schema: CAD schema 2 sketch graphs gain the additive relation {id, kind: point-on-curve, pointId, curveId}. The strict relation union means release 0.0.773 and earlier reject a document that contains it. No migration and no change to existing relation kinds, UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol. The relation compiles to the existing equal-length equation for an arc and distance-to-parameter equation for a circle; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. The trim-sketch-entity preview receipt replaces attachLineId and attachLineIds with attachment and attachments; the edit request schema is unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation or input-version behavior change. WebMCP tools keep their arguments. set-sketch-relation and append-sketch-entities accept the new relation, cad_inspect_sketch_regions reports trimPreview attachment or attachments, and the trim-sketch-entity description and public agent guide describe both.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. In sketches, Coincident accepts a point and an arc or circle in the Constrain tool and the Constrain selection menu; the constraint tool list is unchanged. Drawing snaps along arcs and circles attach with Point on curve while Create relations is on, and Trim keeps new cuts inside cutting arcs and circles on them.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage format change. Saved documents open unchanged; a document saved with the new relation needs this release or later.
checklist.verification: cadSketchPointOnCurveRelations.test.ts checks parsing, the rejected center, arc endpoints and declared aliases, the radial residual beyond the arc span, the reference visitors, delete and split protection, a middle arc trim and a circle trim that keep the relation, and the removal of point-on-line and point-on-curve relations whose point becomes the trimmed edge end. cadSketchPointOnCurvePreparation.test.ts checks with the native solver that each relation removes exactly one freedom, that a drag past the arc end lands on its circle, that the point follows a changed arc radius, circle radius and moved circle center, and that a trim cut kept on an arc follows the arc as it grows. cadSketchTrimOverlaps.test.ts checks the attachment and attachments receipts for line and circle cutters and rejects an attachment at an existing endpoint. cadSketchConstraintTool.test.ts and CadWorkbench.test.tsx check Coincident with a point and an arc or circle in both pick orders, the duplicate and invalid cases, and adding and removing it from the Constrain selection menu. cadFreshSketchDrawing.test.ts, CadSketchCanvasPicking.test.tsx and CadSketchCanvas.test.tsx check on-curve drawing picks, stale curve picks, the snap hint, Create relations on and off, and a Trim cut kept on a cutting circle. The full Vitest suite (548 files, 6172 tests), lint, ui:check, build, solver:check and the release check pass, and e2e cad-sketch-arc-trim, cad-sketch-circle-trim, cad-sketch-constraints, cad-sketch-point-on-line and cad-workflow pass in Chromium.

publicNotes.summary: Coincident keeps a point on an arc or circle.
changes: Coincident accepts a point and an arc or circle. The point stays on the curve's full circle and follows when the curve moves or changes size; the relation list names it Point on curve.
With Create relations on, a point you snap along an arc or circle while drawing stays on it.
Trim keeps a new cut inside a cutting arc or circle on that curve, so a trimmed outline stays closed when the curve changes.
Trimming an edge to an existing point that is held on that same edge now removes that relation instead of failing.
publicNotes.compatibility: Sketches that use Point on curve cannot be opened by release 0.0.773 or earlier. Existing documents are not changed. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: No action needed. Open sketches that use Point on curve with this release or later. Agents that read trim previews should read attachment or attachments instead of attachLineId or attachLineIds.
